serviceParameters.label: Databricks Workspace Profile
serviceParameters.description: Profile in .databrickscfg that selects the workspace + credentials. Optional (defaults to the env-var config). e.g. SP or DoD-FE.

serviceParameters.label: SQL Warehouse HTTP Path
serviceParameters.description: SQL Warehouse HTTP path — for Lakehouse (read-only) services. Copy from the warehouse's Connection Details. e.g. /sql/1.0/warehouses/1857dd2a594736e4.

serviceParameters.label: Table Name
serviceParameters.description: Fully-qualified Databricks table for Lakehouse (read-only) services — catalog.schema.table. e.g. main.geospatial.us_cell_towers.

serviceParameters.label: Geometry Column
serviceParameters.description: Column that holds the geometry. e.g. geom, shape, or wkt_geom.

serviceParameters.label: ID Field
serviceParameters.description: Unique integer ID column used as OBJECTID (must fit a 32-bit int, max 2147483647). e.g. objectid or id (default: id).

serviceParameters.label: Geometry Format
serviceParameters.description: How geometry is stored: WKT, WKB, GEOJSON, or GEOMETRY (native). Optional — auto-detected from the column name. e.g. WKT.

serviceParameters.label: Time Column
serviceParameters.description: Timestamp column enabling time-aware queries. Optional. e.g. event_time.

serviceParameters.label: Lakebase Host
serviceParameters.description: Lakebase (PostgreSQL) host — set this for editable services (routes reads + writes to Lakebase). e.g. ep-bold-dawn-xxxx.database.cloud.databricks.com.

serviceParameters.label: Lakebase Schema
serviceParameters.description: PostgreSQL schema in Lakebase. e.g. geo_demo (default: public).

serviceParameters.label: Lakebase Table
serviceParameters.description: Lakebase table read from / written to. e.g. cases_editable.

serviceParameters.label: Max Record Count
serviceParameters.description: Max features returned per page; clients can request fewer via resultRecordCount. e.g. 2000 (default).

serviceParameters.label: Spatial Reference ID
serviceParameters.description: EPSG SRID of the geometry column. e.g. 4326 (WGS 84, default) or 3857 (Web Mercator).

serviceParameters.label: Editing Enabled
serviceParameters.description: Set true to allow editing via applyEdits (Lakebase only; also add Editing to the service capabilities). e.g. true.
